deviations_from_paper.explanation: Every evidence item is a character range into an emitted text file; verify.py re-slices it and recomputes the share that still matches.

envelope.condition: findings with an explicit verb from the closed set
envelope.note: 6/6 triples on the demo, polarity explicit
the first verb decides; a noun relation is read as the object of 'shows'

envelope.condition: passive voice with an unstated agent
envelope.note: subject is the grammatical subject; no guessing of the agent

failure_modes.impact: no triple; assertion kept with confidence=unspecified and listed in uncertainty
polarity=negative, cue not folded into the subject

failure_modes.mode: noun that looks like a verb (increase)
failure_modes.impact: only chosen if no earlier verb exists

note: This is a skill-authoring challenge: the targets are the demonstration benchmark and the audit, not a paper's reported numbers.
